messages:
maria: Hey team — hitting a weird edge in the JS SDK during onboarding: if the client disconnects and reconnects quickly we sometimes get duplicated final tokens or out-of-order fragments.

alex: Repro?

maria: Minimal: start streaming, force-close the socket (ctrl-c), and reconnect within ~200ms. Node SDK v0.9.1 in our sample app. Output sometimes shows last fragment twice or a partial fragment inserted before the resume token.

ryan: That sounds like a race between our reconnect logic and auth refresh. We debounce outgoing writes for 50ms; if a resume arrives during the debounce window we might replay the buffered chunk.

maria: Repro curl for folks who want to try quickly:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

alex: @ci-bot can you attach the e2e logs from the flaky run?

ci-bot: build #4523 attached: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4523 (streaming-e2e flaky)

sam: Is this only in JS? Our python sdk is line-based; maybe it handles partial delimiters differently.

alex: I ran repro with DEBUG=stream* and saw two flavors: 1) truncated delimiter when client aborts mid-chunk, 2) resume token re-emitted after reconnect due to auth-refresh retry path sending buffered fragment again.

maria: Workaround for now: bump client keepalive to 30s and add a 250ms reconnect backoff. Not great for new users though — onboarding apps try immediate reconnects.

ryan: Suggested fix: add per-chunk sequence IDs server-side and include them in resume metadata. Client dedupes contiguous IDs. Also make the SDK emit an explicit "resumed" event with last-seq so apps can decide to drop duplicates.

sam: I'll add a small sample-app change that toggles quick reconnects and demonstrates dedupe logic + tests. We should also add a parity test between node/python for abort+auth refresh scenarios.

maria: Filing an issue and adding to onboarding checklist so devs don't hit this blind.

maria: issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-3124

alex: Thanks — let's prioritize a small server tag + SDK event patch and an integration test. :thumbsup:
